questions.prompt: Which country's flag is the oldest continuously used national flag?
questions.fact: Legend has it falling from the sky during a battle in 1219, which is not evidence but is a very good story.

questions.prompt: Which sense organ contains the cochlea?
questions.fact: It is coiled like a snail shell, and different points along the coil respond to different frequencies.

questions.prompt: Which country has won the most Olympic hockey gold medals?
questions.fact: It won six consecutive titles between 1928 and 1956, going undefeated across all of them.

questions.prompt: Which television series features a prison called Fox River?
questions.fact: The tattoo covering the escape plan took several hours per shooting day to apply.

questions.prompt: Which country contains the Okavango Delta?
questions.fact: The river never reaches the sea, emptying instead into the Kalahari where it evaporates.

questions.prompt: Which novel is set in the fictional county of Yoknapatawpha?
questions.fact: Its author drew a map of the county and labelled himself its sole owner and proprietor.

questions.prompt: What does the acronym WYSIWYG describe?
questions.fact: Before it, formatting was written as visible codes and you found out how it looked only after printing.
